Shape
Hold Shift while dragging for a perfect square or circle, Alt to grow from the centre. Outline thickness follows the Brush size.
Polygon: click each corner, then double-click, press Enter, or click the first corner again to close it. Esc abandons it.
▸ Auto province
Every province you create here — by New colour, + Land, Generate or Fill area — gets its terrain, barony title and history entry written on export, so you never open a text file.
1 · Numbering
Export renumbers every province to run 1…N without gaps, because CK3 refuses a definition.csv with holes. The generated terrain, title and history files always carry the final ids — auto_provinces.txt in the mod lists which colour became which.

River pen
1px rivers: green source → sea. Red joins, yellow splits.
Hold Shift (or Ctrl) while drawing to branch off an existing river. One end is joined to it, the other is carried downhill to the coast, so the branch is marked yellow where it splits away and gets no source — its water comes from the river it left.
Alt+click on land traces a river downhill to the sea, using the heightmap. It stops when it meets the coast or an existing river, so tributaries are one click.
You are looking at rivers.png itself — white is land, pink is water, nothing else drawn over it.
